answer: Each agent seat must prove its own paid cloud billing account with a zkTLS transcript: at least $25 of compute billed in the last 30 days. One extra identity then costs a $25 monthly invoice plus its own payment card, so 100 sparrow-sized fakes run $2,500 a month, linear in N. Hashes of billing ID and card BIN+last4 pass through a prism-like cross-check, and any collision merges seats. Failure mode: a reseller like Sable Cloud minting sub-accounts under one parent card; the parent org ID in the transcript exposes it, and 1 in 20 seats is re-proven at random.
